The *Tatiyanaya Asaṅgahitenasaṅgahitapadaniddesa* (Dt 2.3) constitutes the third analytical method (*tatiyanaya*) in the *Dhātukathā*, the third treatise of the canonical Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The section examines the categorization of doctrinal phenomena under the standard Abhidhamma matrices according to what is included by means of the unincluded (*asaṅgahitenasaṅgahita*). SuttaCentral lists one translation of the text in one language [SuttaCentral].
